historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as a various automotive uses.
An electrical servicing company occupied part of the building from 1920 to 1941.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 6Z — not individually eligible for the California Register.

unknowns.vnar-930-980-van-ness-avenue-occupancy: The survey's narrative puts an electrical servicing company at 930–980 Van Ness Avenue, a number the avenue does not carry; its evaluation tables record 928 and 950 Van Ness Avenue on the same block. Recorded, not reconciled.
